content:
Maya (Finance): Heads-up 1 AtlasAI says they were charged both a reserved-capacity platform fee and a hosted-monthly platform fee for the same org period after switching to Dedicated mid-cycle. Invoice ids INV-2026-2144 & INV-2026-2145. Customer asks for correction.

Lena (Customer Success): They emailed support: migration effective 2026-06-10, migrated to Dedicated pool. They expected only the reserved platform fee pro-rated for the month.

Suki (Sales): We approved Dedicated reservation mid-term. Sales note: effective 2026-06-10. Did orders sync to billing on time?

billing-bot: INV-2026-2144 (hosted): platform-fee monthly 06/01-06/30 $7,500.
INV-2026-2145 (reserved): platform-fee pro-rated 06/10-06/30 $5,000. Status: both PAID.

Ibrahim (Billing): Our billing run treats Hosted and Reserved as separate service lines. The migration didn't flag the hosted sku as deactivated during the invoice cut because the migration tag landed after job start. So both lines were billed.

Dev (Eng): Confirmed: migration job finished 06/10 17:12 UTC but billing job pulled active skus at 06/10 00:00 UTC. Race condition. Filed BILL-9301 to make migration events atomic with billing snapshot.

Maya (Finance): Customer expectation is single net charge: they shouldn't pay double. The correct net for June would be prorated reserved fee ($5k) plus credit for hosted days after migration. That equates to refunding the hosted portion for 06/10-06/30 = $4k. So credit $4,000.

Ibrahim (Billing): Since both invoices are paid, process: issue credit CN-2026-0099 for $4,000 applied to INV-2026-2144. Then annotate account and re-run statement. Need Sales + CS sign-off before issuing.

Suki (Sales): Approved. Also please include a brief customer note: "Credit issued due to mid-cycle migration overlap; internal ticket BILL-9301 created to prevent recurrence."

Lena (Customer Success): I'll notify AtlasAI and set expectation refund hits card in 1-3 business days. They asked for the internal ticket for audit; include it in the note.

Ibrahim (Billing): Creating credit note CN-2026-0099 now. Memo: "mid-cycle Dedicated migration overlap refund; reference BILL-9301". ETA refund 48h.

Maya (Finance): Please also add a billing playbook step: any migration to Dedicated must set hosted sku to alias before billing snapshot. Add a QA case for mid-cycle snapshot timing.

Dev (Eng): Will push BILL-9301 fix to make migration atomic and add a dedupe in billing export for overlapping platform-fee lines.

billing-bot: CN-2026-0099 created and applied to INV-2026-2144. Refund queued.

Lena (Customer Success): Customer confirmed refund received and account note added. Marking resolved.

Maya (Finance): Great, closing the thread. We'll follow up in BILL-9301 RCA.
